character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: flame-red hair in a high practical ponytail, dark gold eyes, with a distinctive, recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. Character identity: a determined rescue captain leading people through a city in crisis. Signature costume: a soot-marked crimson field jacket, reinforced dark trousers, and heat-resistant gloves. Defining personal item: a battered rescue whistle on a red cord. Keep the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and signature item unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: This theme has one fixed protagonist: preserve the exact character identity in every scene.
Keep the same face, age impression, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume silhouette, materials, colors, and defining personal item consistent; do not randomly redesign the outfit.
Do not replace the protagonist or introduce another lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in wasteland under a fire sky, forge with glowing metal, cliff above a burning horizon; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with ember orange, crimson, charcoal black, gold; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by low-angle shot of flames rising, slow push-in on glowing embers, wide shot of a burning horizon; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
